title: force sudo 1.9.16p2-1ubuntu4
description: I *think* this is the appropriate action. I guess we could also badtest the failing test.
diff:
diff --git a/ubuntu-release b/ubuntu-release
index 93bedc9..d01ee16 100644
--- a/ubuntu-release
+++ b/ubuntu-release
@@ -41,3 +41,7 @@ force-badtest gcc-snapshot/all
 # block coreutils-from while failures are being investigated
 # see LP: #2111603
 block coreutils-from
+
+# sudo is not migrating only because of livecd-rootfs autopkgtests that fail
+# because sudo has not migrated
+force sudo/1.9.16p2-1ubuntu4
